ownerAuthorization: Reuse the existing GitHub OPENAI_API_KEY; existing cost limits and free-credit guard unchanged.

scope.ocr: Missing tools defer only media-dependent verification, never approve it or block unrelated text offers.
scope.community: Exact-post evidence cache, human-decision protection, short-title guidance, quoted field provenance and explicit-year offer dates.
scope.copy: Four bounded candidates per run; quoted Terra proposals, deterministic guards, independent Sol verification, persistent source-bound replay and 24-hour negative-result cache.
scope.expiry: Existing source-proven expiry mechanisms retained with original records, grace period and protected cases.
scope.map: Existing hourly free bounded address reconciliation retained; additional cache-only quality checks.
scope.images: At most two new cached Terra reviews per quality run for website images. No unlicensed photo downloads or automatic rights assumptions. Native image selection not claimed covered.
scope.schedule: 12:00 and 20:00 Europe/Vienna plus relevant changes, with DST and delayed-job guards. GitHub scheduling is not exact-time delivery.
scope.publication: After generated commits, compare all four actual public feed, map and featured documents byte-for-byte. New deals retain human approval during this stage.

cloudVerification.costCaveat: Internal shared-ledger usage, not the provider account balance.

localMigration.otherSchedules: Preserved; no claim blog, SEO, Threads or authenticated support tasks migrated.

websiteImageFollowup.scope: Website symbolic image selection only; explicit product before merchant cuisine, no empty table/closed bag fallback.
websiteImageFollowup.visualChecks: 390x844 and 1440x900, actual loaded assets and no horizontal overflow.

migrationRule: Pause local schedules only after the equivalent server execution succeeds publicly. Keep non-equivalent authenticated tasks separate.
remainingStages: Native image-selection audit and licensed product-photo ingestion beyond website image checking
